restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list word is first tested by an exact packed Y9 prefilter (Lemma PF, 6 units: ADD, AND, ADD, AND, comparison and branch, each counted): enumeration of condition (1) over all 1024 low-10-bit prefixes leaves 14, all satisfying (Y9 + 0x044) & 0x387 == 0 (which holds for 16 of 1024 prefixes, pass share 2^-6), so words with no such lane skip E work losslessly. Before the prefilter, every list word runs the 33-unit low-half Y9 fill (right-shifted low halves of C1.b1 and Y13, which determine bits 0..11 of Y9' exactly, with the lane-safe LO[8] mask kept); kept words complete the high 12 bits of Y1 and full Y9' in 10 units and run the 3-unit word test (AND, comparison, branch).

The walk: every member walks seven full blocks of 2^16 steps, s = L0 + 1 to L0 + 7 * 2^16 with t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^19) below 2^19, starting where X0 mod 2^16 is 2^16 - 1 (Lemma W7); on a full block every listed high half names one step, so a live block reads the first copy of its state's list whole in written-out code (Lemma LW): 24 units per live block, 11 per block, no pieces, ranges or partial words. t < 2^51 and both messages are below 2^61 bytes (memory_log2_bytes 63 covers both with the search and SEL).

The 2^19 members fall into 16 list classes of 32768 (member type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27). Each member reads only the list words alive for its class (Lemma CP: the omega of a listed good trial is alive). The 16 lists come from an exact enumeration with one representative member per class (462791680 tests, kept counts summing to 389525760 = 16 * 24345360); each equals its state's typed list cut by a 128-bit mask on bits 16 to 22 of omega, which the program carries and checks (kept counts, fully checked lanes and planted roots, sampled cut words). E_KEPT = 24345360 replaces E_COUNT = 28924480 in the E budget; the pass and live-block budgets are not lowered. That one member decides its class is the premise H_class. BUILD = 834078790425024 is charged once; a member is 71 units.

Charged-cost tightenings of unchanged work: a passing lane's seven-lane word scan is a certified 12 units (passing lane 52, for 61); the context constant is 436 (for 500); the H1' listed-good-trial factor is 0.974 (for 0.970); SEL is charged S = 4859252056537550848 at the walk's logged maxima (for 5486510246044225536); the packed Y9 prefilter uses a single addition by PF44 = 0x044 (U_PF = 6, for 7, so skipped words cost 43 units instead of 44); and MU = 0.004025 is re-declared from a preregistered run (PREREG6W4) of 16384 whole contexts on the shipped class-list walk program. N = 52137637665479315855, log2(N/430) = 56.75076617, rounded up to 56.7508; WB = 42207635139614084111; W_CTX = 231216664; CREDIT = 4305260410871376165. Budgets, certificate, memory and premises are in the first section and the ledger appendix of proof.md.

heuristics.statement: The inherited listed-good-trial rate and context-level dependence premise of the fa97a08f construction, at the declared rate factor 0.974 (the base filed 0.970); unchanged by the typed-list filtering, the prefilter and the class lists.
heuristics.scope: The same 55/63-byte, flags-3, non-root counter walk and exact solver construction, with the same run length and expected count 0.49594.
heuristics.extrapolation: The rate and dependence are inherited; typed lists, the prefilter and the class lists only remove words that cannot hold a listed good trial (the class lists under H_class), and no change of this entry alters which trials are searched. The factor 0.974 is a declared premise of this entry (change D), supported by the inherited preregistered samples cited in Section 13, not by a new measurement.
heuristics.limitations: This remains a heuristic premise, not a theorem.

heuristics.statement: For a step whose omega is in the list of its member's class, the E-lane and pass counts are at most 1.000173 and 1.002882 times their exact shares, E_KEPT/2^32 per listed step and 14110208*E_COUNT/2^64 per step, plus a Hoeffding reserve over contexts. The class lists only remove list words that cannot hold a listed good trial, so they do not raise either count.
heuristics.scope: All RUN_STEPS outer steps of the full-block walk.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A, 2^36 independent walk steps with the program's own tables: 462,791,000 typed E steps (0.999999 of the exact share) and 1,520,165 passing steps (0.99984); the lower-tail Chernoff rule at exp(-7) gives the factors.

heuristics.statement: The mean metered debit of the declared program per outer step of the class-list full-block walk (the screen's 64 + 20|T| plus the lane's 15 call-only units plus the executed solver ledger) is at most MU = 0.004025 machine units: the mean of the preregistered PREREG6W4 run (16,384 whole contexts of the shipped class-list walk program, 0.0037673 per step, standard error 4.29e-05) plus six standard errors (0.0040248), rounded up to 10^-6; the credit adds a Bernstein reserve (L_C = CAPX * 7 * 2^19) and a preflight reserve.
heuristics.scope: The unchanged screen and capped solver on the class-list walk of seven full blocks per member, over the 2^69.862 outer steps of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: From PREREG6W4, 16,384 whole contexts of the shipped class-list walk program (seeds b'prereg6w4 %d' % s for s = 540,672 to 557,055; 16,384 * 7 * 2^19 = 2^35.807 outer steps, 1,128,526 passing lanes, 281,599 prechecked calls, 38,476 solver calls, 0 mismatches, 0 halts) to the run. The rule (mean plus six standard errors over contexts, rounded up to 10^-6) was written before the run and the whole sample was used: mean 0.0037673 per step, standard error 4.29e-05, MU = 0.004025. No analytical MU scaling.
heuristics.limitations: The debit has a heavy tail (solver calls are rare, one call can debit up to 23151 units), the standard error is a statistical margin and not a proof, the seeds are pseudorandom, and the true mean is not proved. The Bernstein reserve bounds the run total given the mean, not the mean.

heuristics.statement: A block of a walk context is live on average at most 1.000048 times as often as a uniform low half of omega (4,160 of 2^16 for each type), so a context has on average at most that share of its 56 blocks live; the live-block budget adds a Hoeffding reserve over contexts.
heuristics.scope: The 56 full blocks of every context of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A: 30,534,464,639 live blocks among the seven of 2^36 independent members, 0.999998 of the model share; the one-sided empirical Bernstein rule at exp(-7) gives the factor.
heuristics.limitations: The live share of a block depends on the outer words and the member, whose law is not proved uniform.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, (a) the expected number of list words the exact 6-unit Y9 prefilter keeps is at most 0.11 times the expected number of list words, and (b) the expected number of listed entries is at least 0.98 times its exact value E_KEPT * 7 * 2^19 / 2^32 on the class lists.
heuristics.scope: The kept-word and kept-lane work budgets of the counter walk; it does not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: For part (a) on the 6-unit prefilter ((Y9_lo + 0x044) & 0x387 == 0): PREREG6W4 (16,384 whole contexts, seeds 540,672 to 557,055, the shipped program) read 49,072,552 list words and kept 5,130,755 (0.104554; mean over the 8,602 live contexts 0.104538, SE 0.000060, plus 6 SE 0.104897 <= 0.11; the budget charges 1/8). For part (b), listed entries are counted before the prefilter and do not depend on the prefilter: PREREG6W3 (262,144 whole contexts, seeds 278,528 to 540,671) listed 1.00013 of the exact count per context (standard error 0.00258, minus six standard errors 0.98462 >= 0.98), with 0 mismatches and 0 halts. Uniform projections would keep 1-(1-2^-6)^7 = 0.1044 of the words. Earlier runs PREREG6W2 and PREREG6W are reported unpooled in proof.md.
heuristics.limitations: A premise on a work count, like H4' and H_G_cluster; if it failed the run would halt and only the success probability would fall.

heuristics.statement: For each of the 16 list classes (member type t and e1 bits 2, 26, 27) and each typed E word of its type, the word is alive for all 32768 members of the class or for none, so the list built with the class's representative member is the list of every member (with Lemma CP, no listed good trial is skipped).
heuristics.scope: The 16 class lists of the counter walk; it bears on the success probability only, since the work of the walk is that of the stored lists.
heuristics.extrapolation: An exact deterministic enumeration (462791680 tests) with cross-member checks within each class found no disagreement; the program checks the kept count of each walked member's list, that the omega of every fully checked lane and planted root is kept, and that sampled cut words are not alive; two of the fifteen free directions are proved.
heuristics.limitations: Thirteen of the fifteen directions are not proved; an exhaustive check would cost about 2^63 word operations. If the premise failed, a member could miss listed good trials and the success probability would fall below the stated value.
